fusions.name: Run Down
fusions.desc: Sends a ringing pulse that deals 20 damage to the first enemy it meets. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health. Its reach is 50% longer.

fusions.name: Tracking Click
fusions.desc: A thrown click that deals 5 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.6 times at maximum range. Its damage rises 6% per affliction the target carries (max +30%).

fusions.name: Closing Sweep
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Blood in the Water
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 12% against enemies below 50% health.
